name: Zebracat
title: zebracat.ai
shortDescription: Zebracat enables users to transform written content into AI-powered videos quickly. It's designed for creators, marketers, and educators who need to produce engaging video content without manual editing. Users can generate videos with AI avatars, customizable scenes, and clone voices for consistent narration.
cons: Potential privacy concerns with data handling
Dependence on AI might limit creative control
